review.notes: A day at the hospital in the simple past with ने (मीरा दीदी ने कहा), obligation (देना पड़ेगा, आना पड़ेगा) and future. The nurse says आराम कीजिए, दवा लीजिए, कल फिर आइए. "क्लिनिक" is in the plan's title; the text says अस्पताल because क्लिनिक has no reading. The doctor is spoken of with the honorific plural; the child and the woman are not named. Weather and message words are brought back in the story. Words outside the plan (measured, adapter lemmas x tokens): ठंडा×1, थका×1, तभी×1 (under-met).

sentences.text: आज सैम मीरा दीदी के साथ अस्पताल गया।
sentences.english: Today Sam went to the hospital with Meera didi.
The morning was very cold.
The weather was not good.

sentences.text: रात को बारिश हो चुकी थी, और आसमान में बादल थे।
sentences.english: It had already rained in the night, and there were clouds in the sky.
The wind was cold.

sentences.text: मीरा दीदी ने कहा, "आज बहुत मरीज़ आएँगे।"
sentences.english: Meera didi said, "Many patients will come today."

sentences.text: उन्होंने कहा, "सर्दी में लोग बीमार होते हैं, और ज़ुकाम भी होता है।"
sentences.english: She said, "In the cold season people fall ill, and get colds too."

sentences.text: "गर्मी में भी लोग बीमार होते हैं।"
sentences.english: "In the hot season people fall ill too."

sentences.text: सैम ने पूछा, "दीदी, मैं क्या करूँ?"
sentences.english: Sam asked, "Didi, what should I do?"
She said, "Give everyone water."
There was a notice on the wall.
It gave the time of a meeting.
A man came.
He was very tired.

sentences.text: उसे खाँसी थी, और ज़ुकाम भी।
sentences.english: He had a cough, and a cold too.
His throat hurt.

sentences.text: उसने कहा, "मैं बारिश में भीग गया।"
sentences.english: He said, "I got wet in the rain."

sentences.text: "मेरे कपड़े भीगे थे, और मेरे पास छाता नहीं था।"
sentences.english: "My clothes were wet, and I had no umbrella."

sentences.text: मीरा दीदी ने उसका गला देखा।
sentences.english: Meera didi looked at his throat.
The doctor said, "Take this tablet."

sentences.text: "गले के लिए यह दवा बनी है।"
sentences.english: "This medicine is made for the throat."
"Please rest completely."

sentences.text: मरीज़ ने कहा, "मैं दवा ले चुका हूँ।"
sentences.english: The patient said, "I have already taken medicine."
The doctor said, "Come again tomorrow."
Then a child came.
His mother was with him.

sentences.text: बच्चे को बुखार था, और ज़ुकाम भी।
sentences.english: The child had a fever, and a cold too.
His ear hurt.
The child cried.
The doctor looked at his ears.
The doctor said, "We will have to give an injection."
The child shouted a lot at the injection.
Sam held his hand.
Sam brought a bandage.

sentences.text: इंजेक्शन के बाद मीरा दीदी ने पट्टी लगाई।
sentences.english: After the injection Meera didi put on a bandage.
The child laughed.
He ran.

sentences.text: उसकी माँ ने कहा, "इलाज अच्छा है।"
sentences.english: His mother said, "The treatment is good."
"Give medicine for the ear too."

sentences.text: डॉक्टर ने कहा, "यहाँ इलाज हो गया।"
sentences.english: The doctor said, "The treatment is done here."

sentences.text: सैम बोला, "यह इलाज बहुत अच्छा है।"
sentences.english: Sam said, "This treatment is very good."
Sam brought a tablet.
The mother asked, "Is a tablet needed?"
Children run in the field.
Everyone laughed.
It was warm in the room.
At noon there was sunshine.
A woman came.

sentences.text: उसे ग़ुस्सा था, क्योंकि उसे बहुत इंतज़ार करना पड़ा।
sentences.english: She was angry, because she had to wait a long time.

sentences.text: मीरा दीदी ने कहा, "रुकिए, आप यहाँ बैठिए।"
sentences.english: Meera didi said, "Wait, sit here."

sentences.text: औरत के हाथ में पट्टी थी।
sentences.english: The woman had a bandage on her hand.

sentences.text: मीरा दीदी ने पूछा, "आपको कहीं और दर्द है?"
sentences.english: Meera didi asked, "Do you have pain anywhere else?"
The woman said, "No, didi."
"You will have to come again tomorrow."

sentences.text: उसने जवाब दिया, "मैं पूरा दिन काम करती हूँ। मैं आज बहुत काम कर चुकी हूँ।"
sentences.english: She answered, "I work all day. I have already done a lot of work today."
"In my job there is a lot of work."

sentences.text: मीरा दीदी ने कहा, "दस मिनट आराम कीजिए।"
sentences.english: Meera didi said, "Rest for ten minutes."
Just then outside a stranger shouted.
Everyone ran.
The power had gone off outside.

sentences.text: सैम के कपड़े भी भीग गए थे।
sentences.english: Sam's clothes had got wet too.
Sam made a call.

sentences.text: उसने संदेश भेजा, और ख़बर दी।
sentences.english: He sent a message and gave the news.

sentences.text: मीरा दीदी इस अस्पताल में दस साल से काम करती हैं।
sentences.english: Meera didi has worked in this hospital for ten years.

sentences.text: शाम को मेहमान आए, और बैठक भी हुई।
sentences.english: In the evening guests came, and the meeting took place too.

sentences.text: मीरा दीदी ने कहा, "आज सभी मरीज़ ठीक हैं।"
sentences.english: Meera didi said, "Today all the patients are well."
She always smiles.
The doctor always says, "Please rest."
Sam said, "I will always come here."

sentences.text: उसने कहा, "मैं डॉक्टर नहीं बनूँगा, लेकिन मैं सीखूँगा।"
sentences.english: He said, "I will not become a doctor, but I will learn."

sentences.text: मीरा दीदी हँसीं, और चाय बनी।
sentences.english: Meera didi laughed, and tea was made.
